# assignmentB2OliviaColwell

This package provides a function to count missing values across all columns of a data frame grouped by a given variable.

## Installation

Package installation can be done directly by calling 
`devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2OliviaColwell", ref = "0.1.0")`

## Demonstrated Usage

### Usage

`count_all_missing_by_group(data, group_col, .groups = "drop")`

With arguments:

- `data`: Data in data.frame or tibble format

- `group_col`: Column in `data` to group by

- `.groups`: Optional, controls whether the output data frame is grouped. Set to `"drop"` by default

### Examples

This example computes the number of missing values in the `airquality` dataset grouped by the `cyl` column. 

```{r example-1} 
library(assignmentB2OliviaColwell)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```

This example has the same output as the last example, but shows off an alternative way of invoking the `count_all_missing_by_group()`: piping the dataset into the function. 

```{r example-2} 
library(assignmentB2OliviaColwell)
airquality |> count_all_missing_by_group(Month) 
```

The optional `.groups` argument allows us to keep the output grouped by the grouping column. See example below; notice how the output is a grouped tibble, rather than the ungrouped tibble output of the earlier examples. 

```{r example-3} 
library(assignmentB2OliviaColwell)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month, .groups = "keep")
```
